question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Mark Zuckerberg, co-founder and CEO of Facebook, was born in 1984 in White Plains, New York. He developed an interest in computers at a young age, creating a messaging program called ‘Zucknet’ using Atari BASIC. He studied at Phillips Exeter Academy, excelling in fencing and literature. While in high school, he created an early version of Pandora's music software, Synapse, which was considered by companies like AOL and Microsoft but Zuckerberg declined.
